definition_zh: 自治市镇；（英）有议员席位的市镇；（纽约的）行政区
definition_en: a self-governing town, or one of the divisions of a city such as New York
core_image: 挂着自治市铜牌的古老镇公所
scene: 镇公所门前的铜牌擦得锃亮，宣告这座小镇的自治地位。Five boroughs make up New York City.
sceneCN: 这里 borough 是「行政区」（第 2 个义项：大城市的区划单位）；句意是五个行政区组成了纽约市。

derivatives.zh: 苏格兰拼写变体，义为「自治市镇」
法律史用语，义为「幼子继承制」

senses.title: A self-governing town
senses.definition: a town with its own local government and charter
senses.definitionCN: 拥有自己的地方政府与特许状的城镇
senses.example: The borough elected its own mayor and council.
senses.exampleCN: 该自治市镇选出自己的市长与议会。
senses.why: Old English burg was a fortified place; a walled town kept the right to rule itself.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 burg 指设防之地，有城墙的镇便保有自治之权。

senses.title: A division of a large city
senses.definition: one of the official districts of a large city such as New York
senses.definitionCN: 纽约等大城市的法定区划
senses.example: Five boroughs make up New York City.
senses.exampleCN: 五个行政区组成了纽约市。
senses.why: The old self-ruling town became the named district of the modern metropolis.
senses.whyCN: 昔日的自治小镇化为现代都会的命名区划。

senses.title: A parliamentary constituency of old England
senses.definition: a town entitled to send members to Parliament
senses.definitionCN: 有权向议会派遣议员的市镇
senses.example: The borough returned two members to Parliament.
senses.exampleCN: 该选区市镇向议会选送两名议员。
senses.why: Representation grew from the town's charter, not its population.
senses.whyCN: 议席源于镇之特许状，而非人口多寡。

senses.title: A rotten borough of the unreformed system
senses.definition: a nearly empty borough controlled by one patron before reform
senses.definitionCN: 1832 年改革前由一人操控的空心选区
senses.example: Old Sarum was the most notorious rotten borough.
senses.exampleCN: 老萨勒姆是最臭名昭著的腐败选区。
senses.why: Where the voters were few, the owner's word filled the seats.
senses.whyCN: 选民寥寥之地，地主的意志便坐满了席位。

senses.title: An administrative borough in England today
senses.titleCN: 今日英国的自治市镇行政区
senses.definition: a London borough or metropolitan district with local powers
senses.definitionCN: 伦敦自治市镇或都市区等地方行政单位
senses.example: Camden is one of the London boroughs.
senses.exampleCN: 卡姆登是伦敦自治市镇之一。
senses.why: Reform kept the old name for the new units of local rule.
senses.whyCN: 改革以旧名命名新的地方治理单位。

senses.title: The Scottish burgh
senses.definition: the Scottish spelling and system of chartered towns
senses.definitionCN: 苏格兰拼法与特许镇制度
senses.example: Royal burghs dated their charters to the Middle Ages.
senses.exampleCN: 王家自治镇的特许状可溯至中世纪。
senses.why: Scots kept the older spelling of the same word.
senses.whyCN: 苏格兰语保留了同一词更古老的拼法。

senses.title: The Alaska borough
senses.titleCN: 阿拉斯加的「市镇级」政区
senses.definitionCN: 阿拉斯加州相当于县级的政区单位
senses.example: The census lists boroughs instead of counties in Alaska.
senses.exampleCN: 人口普查在阿拉斯加以 borough 取代 county。
senses.why: Alaska chose the old word for its top local tier.
senses.whyCN: 阿拉斯加以这个古词命名其最高地方层级。

senses.title: A historic fortified town
senses.definition: a defended settlement in early English history
senses.definitionCN: 早期英格兰历史中的设防聚落
senses.example: Alfred the Great raised boroughs against the Danes.
senses.exampleCN: 阿尔弗雷德大帝筑设防城镇以御丹麦人。
senses.why: The word began as the wall itself, then the town behind it.
senses.whyCN: 该词始于城墙本身，继而指墙内的镇。

intro.en: Borough comes from Old English burg, a fortified place.
intro.cn: borough 出自古英语 burg「设防之地」。

items.en: burgs meant a hill fort or shelter; cousins include German Burg and the name element -burg.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 burgs 指山堡或庇护所，同族词有德语 Burg 及地名成分 -burg。

items.en: a root bhergh- of height and protection, also behind iceberg's berg.
items.cn: 印欧词根 bhergh- 表「高、护」，iceberg 的 berg 亦同源。

items.en: burg meant fort, then walled town.
items.cn: 古英语 burg 指要塞，后指有墙之镇。

items.en: borough named the chartered, self-ruling town.
items.cn: 中古英语 borough 指持特许状自治的市镇。

items.en: now names city districts in New York, London, and Alaska.
items.cn: 今用于纽约、伦敦与阿拉斯加的政区命名。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the burg root; the near-meaning group gathers city-division words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 burg 词根；近义组收城市区划类词。

entries.definitionCN: 自治市（苏格兰拼法）——同词异拼

entries.definition: to take with intent to return
an area of a country or city
a city or town with local government

normalIntro.en: Borough is the old burg, a walled town, worn down in speech.
normalIntro.cn: borough 是古老的 burg「设防之镇」，读音已磨损。

normal.en: 「The five boroughs of New York」 is a set phrase.
Do not spell it boroughgh or burrough.
Borough sounds like borrow to American ears.
normal.cn: 在美音中它与 borrow 押韵。

normal.en: Scottish burgh keeps the older form.
normal.cn: 苏格兰拼法 burgh 保留旧形。

abstract.en: See a bronze town charter nailed to the guildhall door.
abstract.cn: 看钉在镇公所门上的青铜特许状。

abstract.en: Draw a circle around a city and cut it into five named wedges.
abstract.cn: 在地图上把一座城划成五块有名有姓的扇形。

abstract.en: Feel the stone of a Roman wall still circling a small town.
abstract.cn: 触摸仍环绕小镇的罗马城墙残石。

examples.en: Five boroughs make up New York City.
examples.cn: 五个行政区组成了纽约市。

examples.en: The borough elected its own mayor and council.
examples.cn: 该自治市镇选出自己的市长与议会。

examples.en: Old Sarum was the most notorious rotten borough.
examples.cn: 老萨勒姆是最臭名昭著的腐败选区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泊若」——城泊着一圈城墙，若固若金汤，便是自治市镇 borough。

root: 古英语 burg「设防之地」（日耳曼词根，印欧词根 bhergh-「高、护」，与德语 Burg、iceberg 同源）；中古英语 borough 指持特许状自治的市镇，今用于纽约、伦敦、阿拉斯加的政区名。

sensesIntro.en: From hill fort to chartered town to Manhattan wedge, borough is the story of local self-rule.
sensesIntro.cn: 从山堡到特许镇到曼哈顿的一角，borough 记录着地方自治的演进。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bronze charter nailed to the guildhall door
core.cn: 核心意象：钉在镇公所门上的青铜特许状

branches.en: Chartered towns and their modern heirs
branches.cn: 特许市镇及其现代继承者

intro.en: The burg- root names fortresses across Europe.
intro.cn: burg- 词根在欧洲各地为要塞命名。

latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根，源于印欧语「高处」。
